jobs.purpose: Read the live GitHub admin settings (rulesets, environments, Actions permissions, Apps, runner groups) with GET requests only and diff them against GITHUB_ADMIN_BASELINE.md (D8082). The job holds no write token; a separate job files the drift issues with the workflow token.
requiredPermissions: Repository Administration read
Repository Environments, Secrets and Variables read (names only)
Organisation Administration read and Self-hosted runners read

jobs.purpose: Publish the approved disabled compute host and its container using the separate preview identity.
requiredPermissions: Worker Editor on the approved existing preview host
Containers Write

jobs.purpose: Verify provider keys and manage Secrets Store values and AI Gateway provider aliases on the approved account. Prefer the dedicated gateway administration identity; no Worker setting is changed.
requiredPermissions: AI Gateway provider configuration read/write on the approved agents gateway
Secrets Store secret create/update and metadata reads on the approved store

jobs.purpose: Create, deploy, exercise and delete a throwaway Worker and its D1, KV, R2, queues and Workflow. Requires a separate publishing identity before dispatch.
requiredPermissions: Workers product Admin for throwaway Worker create/delete and Workflow operations
D1 Write
Workers KV Storage Write
Workers R2 Storage Write
Queues Write

jobs.purpose: D8507: after the Stage A job (always), or for an earlier run's id, list the account's resources and delete only that run's Stage A names; fail unless zero are left. Uses the same identity as the stage-a job, so it can delete only what that job could create.
requiredPermissions: Workers product Admin for throwaway Worker and Workflow list/delete
D1 Write
Workers KV Storage Write
Workers R2 Storage Write
Queues Write

jobs.purpose: Publish the dedicated archive observer after its owner enablement gate.
requiredPermissions: Worker Editor on the existing configured archive observer

jobs.purpose: Export D1, upload and read back the R2 backup, and update backup markers. When enabled, put the encrypted copy in independent storage.
requiredPermissions: D1 Write for export
Workers R2 Storage Write for REST objects
Independent store PutObject and HeadObject when enabled

jobs.purpose: Create subsidiary resources, seed its D1, install branch secrets, record its RPC hash at HQ and publish the subsidiary. Requires a separate provisioning identity before dispatch.
requiredPermissions: Workers product Admin for subsidiary creation
D1 Write for subsidiary provisioning and HQ registry update
Workers KV Storage Write
Workers R2 Storage Write
Queues Write
Vectorize Write
Workers Routes Write on the branch zone
BRANCH_SECRET_BUNDLE application values
HQ_RPC_SECRET application identity

jobs.purpose: Migrate and publish each registered subsidiary. Requires a separate rollout identity before a real subsidiary is registered.
requiredPermissions: Worker Editor on each existing registered subsidiary
Workers Routes Write on its zone
D1 Write for each subsidiary database

jobs.purpose: Verify queues, capture the previous deployment, migrate HQ D1 and publish the existing studioos Worker and its configured domains.
requiredPermissions: Worker Editor on studioos
Workers Routes Write on its zone
D1 Write
Queues Read for preflight
Worker-scoped publish authorization covering configured consumer and Workflow updates

jobs.purpose: D7152: after a failed post-deploy smoke on a release classed auto or auto-additive, decide whether to roll back; in act mode only, return studioos to the version preflight recorded and verify it. Runs only when RELEASE_ROLLBACK_MODE is report or act.
requiredPermissions: Worker Editor on studioos (wrangler deployments list and wrangler rollback, act mode only)

jobs.purpose: Compare the live production schema with a local rebuild.
requiredPermissions: D1 Write for schema export

jobs.purpose: Plan or apply the selected D1 maintenance mode. A subsidiary target requires its own scoped identity before use.
requiredPermissions: D1 Write on the selected database
Queues Read for HQ preflight

jobs.purpose: Read and verify backup objects, restore to a throwaway D1, check the restore, clean up and write the drill marker.
requiredPermissions: D1 Write for throwaway create/import/delete
Workers R2 Storage Write for backup reads and markers

jobs.purpose: When FILE_RECOVERY_ENABLED is set, verify the backup bucket's retention lock, then copy counsel-approved record classes to the archive prefix and verify every copy (D6428); when FILE_DR_SECOND_COPY_ENABLED is set, also write the encrypted independent copy outside the production account (D6653).
requiredPermissions: Workers R2 Storage Read on studioos-backups for the bucket lock check
Bucket-scoped S3 object read on the approved source prefixes
PutObject and HeadObject only on the independent destination outside the production account (FILE_DR_COPY_*)
Bucket-scoped S3 object write and read on the archive destination prefix

jobs.purpose: Create a throwaway Worker, run one synthetic gateway call and delete the Worker. Requires a separate publishing identity before dispatch.
requiredPermissions: Workers product Admin for throwaway Worker create/delete and secret installation

jobs.purpose: Request a synthetic sign-in through the application and read D1 to verify insertion and mail acceptance.
requiredPermissions: D1 Read for the verification queries

jobs.purpose: Publish the existing meeting-bot preview, verify its callback, then publish the existing production bot and container.
requiredPermissions: Worker Editor on studioos-meeting-bot-preview and studioos-meeting-bot
Containers Write

jobs.purpose: Publish the existing merge-control Worker with its dedicated queue consumer.
requiredPermissions: Worker Editor on studioos-merge-control
Worker-scoped authorization to attach its configured queue consumer

jobs.purpose: Post the advisory PR-overlap snapshot to the production WorkGraph ingest endpoint using its application-only credential.
requiredPermissions: WORKGRAPH_INGEST_TOKEN application permission to post WorkGraph snapshots

jobs.purpose: Provision, migrate, export, restore, compare and delete a pair of synthetic D1 databases.
requiredPermissions: D1 Write for synthetic create/migrate/export/restore/delete

credentialPolicies.production/CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: Individual Worker Editor on studioos. Workers Routes Write on its zone. D1 Write for migrations and schema access. Queues Read for the release preflight. Verify the configured queue consumer and Workflow updates with this scoped identity.
credentialPolicies.production/MEETING_BOT_CLOUDFLARE_API_TO: Individual Worker Editor on studioos-meeting-bot-preview and studioos-meeting-bot, and Containers Write for their container deployment.
credentialPolicies.production/ARCHIVE_OBSERVER_CLOUDFLARE_A: Individual Worker Editor on the pre-provisioned archive observer named in cloudflare-archive-observer/wrangler.jsonc.
credentialPolicies.production/MERGE_CONTROL_CLOUDFLARE_API_: Individual Worker Editor on studioos-merge-control. Verify attachment of its dedicated queue consumer with that identity.
credentialPolicies.production-ops/CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: D1 Write for export and for rehearsal or restore database creation, import and deletion. Workers R2 Storage Write for the Wrangler REST object operations. No Worker publishing permission.
credentialPolicies.production-backup/CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: D8754: the scheduled D1 backup only. D1 Write on the account, which wrangler d1 export and Time Travel info need; Workers R2 Storage Write limited to the studioos-backups bucket. No Worker, route, queue or D1 database creation or deletion use. Separate from production-ops/CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, so the backup never holds the restore and rehearsal token.
credentialPolicies.production-monitoring/CLOUDFLARE_API_TOK: D8754: D1 Read on the account, for the magic-link probe's verification queries. No write permission of any kind.
credentialPolicies.production-ops/DR_COPY_ACCESS_KEY_ID + D: Independent storage provider identity for PutObject and object metadata checks in the backup destination. Preserve D4558 retention and access constraints.
credentialPolicies.production-backup/DR_COPY_ACCESS_KEY_ID: D8754: the same independent-storage identity, moved with the backup: PutObject and object metadata checks in the backup destination only. Preserve D4558 retention and access constraints.
credentialPolicies.production-ops/BRANCH_SECRET_BUNDLE: Application secrets installed on a provisioned subsidiary. No Cloudflare API permissions.
credentialPolicies.production-ops/HQ_RPC_SECRET: Shared HQ application identity. The job installs its digest on the subsidiary. No Cloudflare API permissions.
credentialPolicies.agent-compute-preview/CLOUDFLARE_API_TOK: Individual Worker Editor on the approved, pre-provisioned disabled preview host, plus Containers Write for its container. Keep the existing independent approval gate.
credentialPolicies.repository/CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: The PR preview consumers were removed by #7146. Verify the isolated preview deploy/cleanup and the environment-backed callers before deleting and revoking the legacy repository token.
credentialPolicies.production-ops/WORKGRAPH_INGEST_TOKEN: Application-only permission to post WorkGraph snapshots. No Cloudflare API access.
credentialPolicies.production-ops/AGENT_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN: Dedicated identity for the approved agents gateway provider configuration and Secrets Store secret create/update and metadata checks. Provision and verify before applying; do not widen the D1/R2 operations token.
credentialPolicies.production-ops/FILE_RECOVERY_SOURCE_* +: Bucket-scoped R2 S3 credentials: read-only on the approved source record-class prefixes, and write plus read-back on the archive destination prefix under the seven-year bucket lock. No D1 or Worker permissions.
credentialPolicies.production-ops/FILE_DR_COPY_ACCESS_KEY_I: Independent storage identity in the account outside production for the encrypted file copy (#6653): PutObject and HeadObject on that destination only, with no list, read-back of plaintext or delete, and no Cloudflare permissions. Provision only when FILE_DR_SECOND_COPY_ENABLED is set.
credentialPolicies.production-ops/ADMIN_DRIFT_READ_TOKEN: Fine-grained read-only GitHub token for the weekly admin drift check (D8082): repository Administration, Environments, Secrets and Variables read (metadata and names only), organisation Administration and Self-hosted runners read. No write permission of any kind and no Cloudflare access. The name is proposed by D8082 until #8063 records the credential.
credentialPolicies.production-monitoring/ADMIN_DRIFT_READ_T: Fine-grained read-only GitHub token for the weekly admin drift check (D8082), in production-monitoring since D8754: repository Administration, Environments, Secrets and Variables read (metadata and names only), organisation Administration and Self-hosted runners read. No write permission of any kind and no Cloudflare access. The name is proposed by D8082 until #8063 records the credential.
